headline: The world spent around $300 billion so the year 2000 would be boring.
slides: Old computers stored years as two digits. 00 could mean 1900.
Banks, power grids, planes: what would happen at midnight?
Programmers spent years rewriting code. Estimates run from $300 to $600 billion worldwide.
A few did: one video store customer got a late fee for renting a film for 100 years.
Because it worked, people decided it had been hype.
